mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 9% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as high unemployment indicates a weakening labor market and potential economic downturn.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when the unemployment rate exceeds 9%, despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a decline in housing starts and an increase in consumer spending signals a shift in demand from housing to other sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between housing starts and consumer spending is not significantly negative over any 2-year rolling window, or the S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher when this interaction occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals an increase in supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when industrial production is increasing, despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signals an expansionary monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index is not significantly negative over any 2-year rolling window, or the S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher when this interaction occurs.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above 130,000 signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when payroll employment exceeds 130,000, despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP signals a decrease in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when GDP is declining, despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between an increase in industrial production and a decline in housing starts signals a shift in supply from housing to other sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between industrial production and housing starts is not significantly negative over any 2-year rolling window, or the S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher when this interaction occurs.
